title: Comparative evaluation of amoxicillin loading and release behavior from waste-derived hydroxyapatite synthesized by solid-state and wet chemical routes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35617-35633
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06021D, Paper
Open Access

Mashrafi Bin Mobarak, Sumaya Tabassum, Md Sohag Hossain, Nourin Tarannum, Fariha Chowdhury, Md. Sahadat Hossain, Nazmul Islam Tanvir, Samina Ahmed
This work compares amoxicillin loading and release from hydroxyapatite synthesized via solid-state and wet chemical routes using waste eggshells, showing how synthesis pathway governs drug delivery performance.
